name: Google Cloud Storage Free Tier
free_limit: 5 GB-months regional Cloud Storage, 5,000 Class A and 50,000 Class B operations/month in eligible US regions; up to 100 GB eligible outbound transfer/month
watch_out: Storage/operations Free Tier applies only to us-east1, us-west1 and us-central1, aggregated across these regions. The 100 GB North America outbound allowance excludes destinations in China and Australia; not all egress routes are free. Billing account/payment method required; unsupported locations, storage classes and overages may be billed.
